name: Devrunway
description: Modular SDLC plugin for any tech stack. Run /setup to declare your tools (frontend, backend, DB, auth, CI, etc.), and devrunway installs only the matching standards, pre-wires MCP servers, and activates a runtime of 35 hooks that block secrets, enforce conventional commits, and catch SQL injection, XSS, PII-in-logs, and more on every save.
longDescription:
Ships **37 skills**, **7 agents**, **2 commands**, **4 hooks** and **7 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (37): `accessibility` (Web accessibility (a11y) standards — semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, focus management, forms, dynamic content), `adr` (Create a numbered Architecture Decision Record in docs/adr/ using the Nygard format), `api-conventions` (Universal REST API design principles — response envelope, route naming, versioning, pagination, status codes), `branch` (Manage git branches and scaffold new feature boilerplate), `checklists` (Universal quality checklists for every development action — feature addition, API endpoint, data model change, logging, secrets, auth), `conventional-commit` (Conventional commit message standards — type/scope/description format, breaking changes, when to use each type), `data-governance` (Data privacy and governance standards — PII field identification, GDPR/CCPA right to erasure, data retention, consent tracking, and…), `debug` (Debug a bug or check production logs by delegating to the debugger agent), and 29 more
- **Agents** (7): `code-reviewer` (Thorough code review of a branch against all standards), `debugger` (Use when investigating bugs, errors, crashes, or unexpected behaviour), `eval-runner` (Runs eval cases from .eval.yaml files), `layer-consultant` (Loads a single layer's detail file and answers a focused question about its rules), `security-reviewer` (Security-focused code review), `skill-forge` (Automated TDD loop agent for skill files), `stack-dispatcher` (Scans installed layers/, matches their paths globs against target files, fans out to layer-consultant sub-agents in parallel, and…)
- **Commands** (2): `eval` (Run eval cases for one skill, a category, or all skills), `forge` (Automated TDD loop for skill files)
- **Hooks** (4): `PostToolUse`, `PreToolUse`, `Stop`, `UserPromptSubmit`
- **MCP servers** (7): `github`, `figma`, `jira`, `gitlab`, `linear`, `confluence`, `notion`

Installs with `claude plugin install devrunway@claude-community` from `manikumarkv/devrunway-claude-plugin`.
